assumption_notes: Receivables arrive on their expected date, in full. Payables leave on their expected date. Non-base currencies are valued at the last rate known at the cutoff. No adjustments.
Every receivable arrives 14 days later than its expected date (rolled to the next business day). Amounts, payables and FX are as in BASE.

Receivables arrive 21 days late and only 90% is collected; every non-base currency is worth 10% less in base currency (applied to flows and to the opening balance); large one-off payments cost 1.5 times their scheduled amount.
